policy: Source conditions, handwritten answers and independent calculations remain separate. All eleven E1 types are connected in the current worktree using verified finite pools. Deployment, publisher approval and empirical student difficulty calibration are separate. No validation of the legacy generic 3D renderer is claimed.

items.handwritingConflict: The original handwritten side profile disagrees with independent reconstruction of the printed solid. The learner answer follows the printed solid, not the handwritten profile.
items.reason: The six source-visible top faces require all ten cubes. Enumeration excludes any extra hidden columns. Source, easy and harder view tasks are separate contracts.

Each labelled top cube is removed separately. Only FRONT and RIGHT preservation determine the primary answer. Hard adds a separate TOP-change question without changing the primary contract. Source coordinates, exact own-face glyph visibility, full grids and A4 are checked.
Original count is retained. Visible projections and count independently reconstruct the single stack and match the verified answer image contract.

The six visible support columns consume all ten source cubes. Independent source/answer review and every finite view contract match. Easy supplies FRONT and asks RIGHT only; source asks FRONT/RIGHT; hard adds BACK/LEFT.
Original projection-only conditions retain no total clue. Visible conditions independently reconstruct the single stack and match the verified answer image contract.

Add two cubes at the first labelled column and one at the second. Source keeps TOP given and asks RIGHT only. Easy supplies the initial RIGHT; hard asks RIGHT and FRONT. Every fixed changed solid and full occupied grid is checked.

items.handwritingConflict: Handwritten top view does not match the independently traced printed solid after the three marked removals.
items.reason: The eleven source cubes and three black cells are independently traced. All three are removed together, without gravity reinterpretation. Source asks TOP, FRONT and RIGHT, preserving the empty front row and side column. The independent printed-solid calculation, not the conflicting handwriting, supplies the learner answer.

solidOperations.sourceContract: Example 2 removes each labelled cube separately and preserves FRONT/RIGHT only. Mission 5 keeps TOP given and asks RIGHT only. Mission 6 removes all three black cells and asks TOP/FRONT/RIGHT with empty rows and columns retained.
solidOperations.independentReview: Separate source reconstruction and contract calculation; a read-only geometry reviewer checked actual glyph ink against its own TOP face, not any labelled face. Two initial glyph-placement errors were fixed and the final fifteen canonical PNGs were inspected.
solidOperations.printReview: All thirty-nine final A4 pages inspected using nine contact sheets after black font, caption counting, title wrapping, empty spill page and per-page margin fixes. Mission 5 hard solution fits two pages without shrinking its marked solid.
solidOperations.renderLimit: Canonical font size 28 only. Optional size 32 fails closed when two Example 2 label faces have no room. This is not blanket approval of arbitrary glyph sizes or arbitrary solids.
solidOperations.difficultyLimit: Easy supplies a projection; source preserves the original task; hard adds a separately requested projection or label set. Explanation step counts are not measured cognitive workload. No empirical student calibration or publisher answer approval.
solidOperations.releaseLimit: Local finite-pool release only. Original PDFs are read-only and not published. Canonical model manifests and pure calculation modules do not independently authorize learner release. Deployment is separate.

solidObservationMission1.pickerFinitePoolCheck: Twelve requested questions produce only the three verified distinct variants; remaining unverified E2 source types must stay disabled.
solidObservationMission1.singleAnswerEvidence: Six independently traced source-visible top faces require all stated cubes; count-only enumeration has exactly one candidate before visibility filtering.
solidObservationMission1.renderEvidence: Existing Three.js renderer retained; exact canonical pixels and independent depth rays check all required top faces. Full occupied 2D answer grids are compared, and moved-cell negative controls must fail despite unchanged column totals.
solidObservationMission1.independentReview: Separate source reconstruction, all nine grid contracts, sampled desktop/mobile/A4 eyes. Two initial findings fixed: complete occupied grids and easy-level request excluding the supplied view.
solidObservationMission1.difficultyLimit: Easy supplies FRONT; source keeps the two original views; hard adds BACK/LEFT. Structural task comparison, not empirical student calibration or publisher approval.

solidObservation.singleAnswerEvidence: Independently traced visible top faces plus total count; all mandatory support cubes consume the stated total. Count-only enumeration is a superset before visibility filtering, and it has exactly one candidate at the stated total. Larger-total candidates are not claimed to be hidden.
solidObservation.renderEvidence: Reused existing Three.js renderer; analytic depth rays match raster colors and all six source-critical top faces remain visible in every tested variant and viewport.
solidObservation.difficultyLimit: Easy supplies the top projection. Source keeps three original views. Hard adds back and left views. Not empirical student calibration.
solidObservation.officialKeyLimit: Printed original solid independently reviewed; handwritten side view conflict retained. Not publisher approval.

learnerStackBank.easy: Give one occupied cell's height, reducing independent reconstruction search.
learnerStackBank.source: Keep original three projections; Example 4 also keeps total, Mission 3 adds no total.
learnerStackBank.hard: Example 4 first derives total from floor cells and added cubes. Mission 3 first derives a missing front height from the two-column sum.
learnerStackBank.difficultyLimit: Structural source-level match, not empirical student calibration.
learnerStackBank.reviewLimit: Prior independent model/renderer reviewer evidence is retained. Current learner-visible voxel enumeration is a separate calculation implementation, not a new secondary-agent review.
learnerStackBank.visualReview: Primary direct eyes sampled original-level A4 problem/solution, hard Mission 3 A4 problem/answer key, easy 320px problem and original 320px solution. Automated bounds and exact answer pixels cover all eighteen PDFs.

verification.visualReview: Direct source, desktop, mobile and A4 raster inspection; independent sampled eyes confirmed final equation wrapping, normal font, grid directions and source sum. An initial low-resolution footprint misreading was retracted after enlarged raster and re-enumeration. Not an eye check of all twenty-four PDFs.
verification.difficultyLimit: Source level preserves each task. Easier adds a useful scaffold. Harder reconstructs a height, derives total from floor and added cubes, or converts edge length to unit face area before the source task. No empirical student difficulty calibration claimed.
verification.secondaryMathReviewer: Existing read-only agent; learner SVG inputs and independent voxel/camera calculations, not producer answers or model metadata.
verification.scopeLimit: No validation of the legacy isometric cube renderer. The four released types use source-derived 2D height charts and orthographic grids.

locked3DModelReview.pixelNegativeControl: Normal reference rejects a highest cube actually removed from the GPU scene; a wrong near-edge color is rejected without a broad face-edge exemption.
locked3DModelReview.sourceTotalContract: Example 4 retains eight cubes. Mission 3 has no total clue.
locked3DModelReview.renderingContract: Opaque unit cubes, orthographic camera, depth-tested black edges, source directions; same-font direction labels inside decoded canonical PNG.
locked3DModelReview.scopeLimit: Internal model-review page only. No learner bank generation, difficulty approval, printed fallback integration or release claimed.
